rationale: Although price has slipped slightly below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($80.93) over the last three 1-minute bars, the pullback of $0.56 is approximately half of a 5-minute ATR ($1.02) and remains well above both the $79.95 invalidation level and session VWAP ($79.12). Furthermore, with the bid-ask spread widened to 33.5 bps ($80.61 x $80.88), exiting prematurely at market incurs heavy friction while the broader intraday uptrend on 3.80x relative volume remains intact.
